razonamiento: Merged visual and spoken elements into a single coherent architecture graph. The visual reading identified six components: Route 53, ALB, EKS, SNS, SQS, and UserCompanyDeveloper. The narration confirmed each component, providing context: the user accesses the Orion portal, Route 53 resolves DNS to the ALB, traffic enters EKS pods/jobs running on EC2 Spot Instances, and job lifecycle events are published to SNS, fanned out to SQS, and monitored by replacement jobs. Internal pod-to-job interactions within EKS were consolidated into the EKS node. All five drawn lines correspond to spoken flows and are marked with procedencia 'ambas', while the spoken flow of replacement jobs polling SQS is recorded with procedencia 'hablada'.
nombre: Automated Environment Provisioning with Amazon EKS and Spot Instances
